menu_reset_account_help: Deletes your save data. Only do this if you're 100% sure this is what you want to do.
dialog_are_you_sure_you_want_to_clear_pr:
This process is irreversible.

Your loadout will be wiped and you will be reset to infamy 0, level 0.

Are you 100% certain you want to do this?
dialog_abort_mission_text:
Are you sure you want to exit the current heist?

You and your crew will be returned to the lobby where you can pick another heist.
